_meta.purpose: Component pool for combinatorial place names and descriptions.
_meta.note: This is the LLM's contribution to the seeded generator. The numeric columns come from the seeded RNG; the prose comes from here. Titles are prefix + core + ' ' + suffix, which yields prefix*core*suffix unique combinations.

situation: at the edge of the marsh
in the middle of open farmland
at the head of the valley
on the boundary of two parishes
at the end of a sunken lane
on a low island in the flood plain
under a stand of nine poplars
at the foot of the escarpment
on ground that drains the wrong way
detail: the bell is rung by wind alone
no two surveys agree on its height
the frost holds there until midsummer
the well is warmer than the air above it
every offering left there is gone by morning
the shadows fall inward rather than outward
the stones are counted differently each year
the water runs clear in drought and cloudy in rain
birds nest everywhere around it but never on it
the door has no hinges and opens anyway
sound arrives there twice
the moss grows only on the southern face
the path to it is shorter on the way back
it appears on maps drawn before it was built
the roof timbers came from somewhere considerably older
nothing planted there has ever taken root
the inscription is legible only when wet
the ferry is always just about to leave
the reflection arrives before its owner
the toll is a riddle rather than a coin
the fire needs neither wood nor thanks
the reeds part for boats and close behind them
the bell can be heard but not found
the wolfsbane refuses to grow within sight of it
